# Cost tracks the size of the index

Evidence sits beside the claim.

---

# A slide that carries its own script loses the room

Retrieval reads from an index that grows with the corpus. Its cost follows the size of that index,
so a larger model costs no more to serve. Fine-tuning pays for every parameter on every call, which
is why its cost climbs with the model, whatever the corpus holds.
